timelineBlocks: 483 BCE: First Buddhist council convened by Ajatashatru
383 BCE: Second Buddhist council convened by Kalasoka
326 BC: Alexander invaded Indian subcontinent, and defeated Porus in the battle of Hydaspes (Jhelum)
321 BCE: Mauryan Empire founded by Chandragupta Maurya;
261 BCE: Battle of Kalinga took place
250 BCE: Third Buddhist council convened by Ashoka
2300–1750 BC: Indus Valley Civilization (Harappan culture) existed.
1500 BC: Aryans came to India.
563 BC: Gautama Buddha was born.
540–468 BC: Mahavira (founder of Jainism) lived.
327–326 BC: Alexander invaded India.
322 BC: Chandragupta Maurya started Maurya Empire.
269 BCE: Ashoka became ruler
261 BCE: Kalinga war took place

72 CE: 
Fourth Buddhist council convened by Kanishka
78 AD: Saka era began.

319: 
[[Gupta dynasty]] started by Sai Gupta (Golden Age of India).

380 AD: 
Chandragupta II (Vikramaditya) became king.

606: 
Harshavardhana ruled ( 606-647).
712 AD: Muhammad bin Qasim invaded Sindh (first Arab attack).
712: Invasion of Sind by [Muhammad Bin Qasim](((vhAtmDLHy)))
1000: Mahmud of Ghazni attacked India, in total 17 times, and looted Somnath Temple.

1001: 
Battle of Peshawar, where Mahmud of Gahazni defeated Jayapala, ruler of Hindu Kush Dynasty.

1001: 
Battle of Waihind, where Mahmud of Gahzni defeated Anandapapa, ruler of Hindu Kush Dynasty.

1024: 
Mahmud of Ghazni invaded Solanki dynasty and plundered Somnath temple.

1191: 
Battle of Terrain-I, where Prithviraj Chauhan defeated Muhammad Ghori

1192: 
Battle of Terrain-II, where Prithviraj Chauhan was defeated by Mohammad Ghori and Delhi came under Muslims.

1194: 
Battle of Chandewar, where Mohammad Ghori defeated Jayachandra of the Gahadavala dynasty and captured Kannuj

1206: 
Establishment of Delhi Sultanate by Qutb-ud-din Aibak

1296: 
Alauddin Khilji ruled (famous for market reforms).

1398: 
Timur's invasion of Delhi; weakened Sultanate

1498: 
Vasco da Gama reaches Calicut; Portuguese arrival in India

1510:
Battle of Goa in which Portuguese defeated Bijapur ruler and captured Goa.

1526: 
Babur defeated Ibrahim Lodi in the First Battle of Panipat and founded the Mughal Empire in India.

1527: 
Battle of Khanwa (Babur defeated Rana Sanga).

1527: 
Babur defeated Rana Sanga of Mewar in the Battle of Khanwa and strengthened Mughal rule in north India.

1528: 
Babur defeated Medini Rai in the Battle of Chanderi and captured the fort to control Malwa region.

1529: 
Babur defeated the Afghans and Bengal forces in the Battle of Ghaghra and secured eastern territories.

1539: 
Humayun was defeated by Sher Shah Suri in the Battle of Chausa and lost control of Bihar region.

1540: 
Humayun was again defeated by Sher Shah Suri in the Battle of Kannauj and fled from India, ending early Mughal rule temporarily.

1556: 
Second Battle of Panipat (Akbar defeated Hemu).

1600: 
British East India Company established on 31 December 1600

1658 AD: 
Aurangzeb became Mughal emperor.

1707: 
Death of Aurangzeb; decline of Mughal Empire

1757: 
Battle of Plassey took place in which British (Robert Clive) defeated Siraj-ud-Daulah (British became strong in Bengal).

1764: 
Battle of Buxar in which British defeated combined forces of Mir Qasim, Shuja-ud-Daula, Shah Alam II.

1765: 
Treaty of Allahabad
1857: Revolt of 1857 (First War of Independence); started as Sepoy Mutiny, spread widely but suppressed

1885: 
Indian National Congress founded by A.O. Hume

1905: 
Partition of Bengal (by Lord Curzon; sparked Swadeshi Movement).
Partition of Bengal by Curzon; sparked Swadeshi Movement

1906: 
All India Muslim League formed Dhaka

1915: 
Gandhi returns to India from South Africa

1919: 
Jallianwala Bagh massacre happened.
Rowlatt Act passed; Jallianwala Bagh massacre in Amritsar by Dyer
1920: Non-Cooperation Movement launched by Gandhi; included boycott of British goods, Khilafat alliance
1920: Non-Cooperation Movement started by Gandhi.
1922: Chauri Chaura incident; Gandhi suspends Non-Cooperation
1928: Simon Commission boycotted ("Go Back Simon")

1929: 
**Lahore Session of Congress**; demand for Purna Swaraj (Complete Independence)

1930: 
**Civil Disobedience Movement** started (Dandi Salt March).

1931: 
**Gandhi-Irwin Pact**; Gandhi attends Second Round Table Conference

1935: 
[[GoI Act 1935]]; provided provincial autonomy
1942: **Quit India Movement** launched ("Do or Die"); mass arrests of leaders
1942: **Quit India Movement** started (Bharat Chhodo).
1946: **Cabinet Mission Plan**; proposal for united India with loose federation

1947: 
**Indian Independence Act**; partition into India and Pakistan; independence on 15 August 1947
**Mountbatten Plan accepted**; led to partition and independence
India became independent (15 August); Partition happened.
1950: India became a Republic (26 January; Constitution came into force).
